_comment: Night Watch permissions. 2026-08-09: git/npx were denied on two consecutive
nights while cat/ls/grep worked. The difference: cat/ls/grep were allowed at
the BINARY level (Bash(cat:*)) while git/npx were allowed only at the
SUBCOMMAND level (Bash(git status:*)), which does not match `git -C <path> log`,
`cd x && git status`, or anything piped. Fix: allow the binary, then deny the
dangerous subcommands. Deny beats allow, so the guards still hold — and
Bash(npx tsx:*) is now a blanket deny, which is TIGHTER than the five
money-script prefixes it replaces (a new money script is denied by default).
